Olly

May 22
2 min read

Little Olly was found by Slobodanka in an abandoned pit toilet after he and his siblings had lost their mother and fell inside. She rescued them all and gave them a second chance at life.


Now this little cheerful fella needs a home of his own!


Things you should know about Olly



✔️DOB January 2026

✔️mixed breed

💕weighs around 6kg, should be around 15kg at full size


  • Not house/ toilet-trained- he’ll need some time to learn house rules but with his young we’re sure he’ll master them in no time

  • He is placed in a pen for puppies - they all sleep in a doggie house for now.

  • Olly is pure joy to be around - independent, curious, and always ready to explore the world. Every day he loves discovering new things, meeting new friends, and learning something new.

  • Olly lives with 44 dogs, both young and old ones. He’s wonderful with other dogs and especially adores the bigger ones.

  • Not familiar with kids, but if need to, we’ll try to arrange him to meet some kids and check his behavior. ( we’re almost 100% sure he’d be wonderful and playful)

  • He absolutely loves people and quickly becomes everyone’s friend.

  • Toys, ropes, playtime and digging- they’re his favorite things in the world, and watching him happily play around is pure joy.

  • Needs some practice with walking on a leash

  • Not familiar with cats

  • Vaccinated, healthy

  • Castration is mandatory once he’s old enough


How do you adopt Olly?


Adoption requires a pre-adoption questionnaire, home check and an adoption contract.


You will need to pay for Olly’s transportation, and pay for the paperwork to get him to you.

The costs are typically €500-650 in total per puppy, depending on where you are located.


We used to be able to charge a little less but unfortunately, due to brexit, the costs of passports, documentation and travel have been increased by our suppliers.


For more information please contact our facebook page or email misisrescue@gmail.com


To apply for Olly please fill in our adoption questionnaire.
